=={{header|Omegese}}==
{{works with|omc|sha256 2c824805, aien-dev/omega-mv e5b32567, Linux AArch64}}
Omega has no imports, so the small output helpers (<code>emit</code> and friends) are part of the program.
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
om2
text nl "\n"
text sp " "
note emit writes every byte of a to stdout; a short write is retried, an error exits 1
fn emit a view uchar * to void
o = ulong 0
while lt o len a bound 4096
k = write 1 a o sub len a o
if le k 0
exit 1
end
o = add o ulong k
end
end
note emitu writes n in decimal; 20 digits hold every ulong
fn emitu n ulong to void
d = new uchar 20 0
i = ulong 20
v = n
while true bound 20
i = sub i 1
put d i uchar add rem v 10 48
v = div v 10
if eq v 0
break
end
end
emit part d i sub 20 i
end
note cat copies x then y into r and returns the length
fn cat x view ulong * y view ulong * r edit ulong * to ulong
for i ulong len x
put r i get x i
end
for i ulong len y
put r add len x i get y i
end
ret add len x len y
end
fn main to int
a = new ulong 3 0
b = new ulong 4 0
c = new ulong 7 0
for i ulong 3
put a i add i 1
end
for i ulong 4
put b i add i 4
end
n = cat a b c
for i ulong n
if gt i 0
emit sp
end
emitu get c i
end
emit nl
ret 0
end
</syntaxhighlight>
{{out}}
<pre>
1 2 3 4 5 6 7
</pre>
